notes:
Release candidate for 2.1.0. Foundry v14 required (v13 support dropped).

Changes

  • Journal Viewer: added a Back button; centred the button layout.
  • Ranged NPC/mech strikes: fixed so ranges display on the sheet in v14 (encoded as range-increment traits; 65 strikes).
  • NPC gear: 137 weapons/armor/shields now link to their compendium items.
  • Mech abilities: Atlas / YMIR / Rampart special attacks now have clickable damage & save rolls.
  • Unarmed strikes: the four weaponless NPCs now have a Fist attack.
  • Fix: registered the missing SF2e Items compendium.
